title: make test runs the kit's tests and stops on the first failure
requirement: The kit has one entry to the checks that execute it: make test runs every plugin test file (and the files under scripts/test) through node --test, then every scripts/*-proof.mjs, in path order, one process each; the first non-zero exit stops the run with a non-zero status, and ONLY=<substring> runs a subset.
reason: The runner is itself the command under test; it has no test file and the red it stops on today is a stale plugin test owned by another task (plugins/orchestrator/test/policy-gating.test.mjs), so an automated case here would encode a red suite. Verified by running make test and node scripts/test-all.mjs and quoting exit codes.
steps: cd /home/iustimov/dsh-kit && make test ONLY=delegation -> 3/3 passed (2 plugin test files, 1 proof script), exit 0
node scripts/test-all.mjs --list -> 70 of 70 step(s) selected (53 plugin test files, 1 scripts/test file, 16 proof scripts)
node scripts/test-all.mjs --only no-such-path -> exit 1 with 'refused: no test file or proof script matches --only ...'
make test -> stops at plugins/orchestrator/test/policy-gating.test.mjs with 'FAIL ... (exit 1, ... ms); stopped after 34 of 70 step(s), 36 never ran'; the runner exits 1 and make reports status 2
expected: A subset runs green and lists its own summary; a filter that matches nothing is refused with exit 1 instead of reporting a pass over zero files; the first failing file stops the whole run, names the file and counts the steps that never ran.
